import re

# Login to Gmail
creds = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
print('gmail_password_found', 'gmail' in creds)

gmail_password = creds['gmail']
access_token = apis.gmail.login(username='jamie-solomon@gmail.com', password=gmail_password)['access_token']
print('gmail_access_token_prefix', access_token[:10])

# Search for outgoing threads mentioning anniversary
page_index = 0
all_threads = []
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=access_token, query='anniversary', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-updated_at')
    threads = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('success', [])
    print('page', page_index, 'threads_returned', len(threads))
    if not threads:
        break
    all_threads.extend(threads)
    page_index += 1

print('total_threads', len(all_threads))
# Print top few subjects and ids
for t in all_threads[:10]:
    print('thread_id', t['email_thread_id'], 'subject', t.get('subject'), 'to_emails_sample', [p['email'] for p in t.get('participants', [])][:3], 'created_at', t.get('created_at'))
